# OpenSheet 0.1

Open-source TypeScript spreadsheet. Current implementation docs take precedence over design and planning documents. The workspace is the unreleased 0.2.0-dev.0 development candidate; 0.1.1 is a published preview.

- README.md: project overview, demos and package map
- CONTRIBUTING.md: local setup, development, validation and deployment
- docs/api.md: public APIs and examples
- docs/plugins.md: plugin lifecycle and capabilities
- docs/implementation-status.md: supported behavior and limits
- ROADMAP.md: proposed milestones and acceptance gates, not shipped capabilities
- TODO.md: planned execution backlog, dependencies and definitions of done
- docs/competitive-research.md: dated competitor evidence and strategic gaps
- schemas/workbook.schema.json: native snapshot schema
- schemas/commands.schema.json: local command schemas
- api-manifest.json: entry points, commands and errors
- examples/headless.ts: compile-checked headless usage
- examples/plugin.ts: compile-checked plugin

Main entry: opensheet; stylesheet: opensheet/style.css. Scoped packages: @opensheetjs/*. Use setValues for literal data and setFormulas for formulas. All writes go through commands. Workbook I/O and transactions are asynchronous; await them and use the scoped transaction facade. Numeric range ends are exclusive. Never mutate internal records or claim full Excel compatibility. Dispose instances on unmount.

Current engine: asynchronous Worker + IndexedDB, bounded caches and atomic staged revisions. API: docs/api.md. Performance example and measurement protocol: docs/performance.md.
